versions.changelog: Scripts now use the Python standard library only (no pip install); structured guidance when the API key is missing.

Any AdsTurbo plan can now call the API (Pro is no longer required); usage is billed in credits. Clearer hints for 2100 (1080p+/4K need a subscription) and 2103 (custom digital humans need Pro). 任何套餐都可以调用 API，不再要求 Pro。

Explains how to get an AdsTurbo API key (sign up, then Workspace → API → Create API Key at https://adsturbo.ai/iris/api); the agent now tells users what to do when the key is missing, invalid, or the plan needs upgrading. 说明如何获取 AdsTurbo API Key，缺 Key、Key 无效或需要升级套餐时 agent 会直接告诉用户怎么做。
Version aligned with the AdsTurbo 1.2.0 skill set; no functional changes. 与 AdsTurbo 1.2.0 统一版本，功能无变化。
Tag the API-key signup link with channel=clawhub for attribution.
Bilingual (English + Chinese) skill body and description.
